english.note: Use this for a professional correspondent who sends written reports to a news organization, including one based elsewhere.

examples.english: This overseas correspondent edits the interview material before sending it back to the newspaper.
examples.traditional: 呢位駐外通訊員要將採訪內容編輯好先寄返報社。
